- Paid by credit card or BC OnLine account: $refund_value CAD, including the service fee, goes back to the original payment method in 10 to 14 business days.
- Paid by Pre-authorized Debit (PAD): there is no charge if cancelled before 7:00 pm Pacific on the purchase day. If cancelled after 7:00 pm, the refund goes to the PAD account in 10 to 14 business days.
- Paid by mailed payment to BC Registries Services: there is no automatic refund. The recipient calls 1-877-370-1033.

The email also says:
- It cannot notify the recipient when the refund is processed.
- The recipient should contact the registry if nothing arrives after 14 business days.
- It links to www.bcregistry.ca/namerequest.

## Conclusions

- The refund endpoint only accepts invoices already in `PAID`, `APPROVED` or `UPDATE_REVENUE_ACCOUNT`. So `CREATED`, `REFUND_REQUESTED`, `REFUNDED` and `CANCELLED` invoices are refused. A second refund fails for the same reason.
- `DirectPayService.process_cfs_refund` is stricter: it needs `PAID` or `UPDATE_REVENUE_ACCOUNT`. An `APPROVED` DIRECT_PAY invoice that passes the generic check is refused with `INVALID_REQUEST`. In the test this path is mocked and a `DIRECT_PAY_INVALID_RESPONSE` is returned.
- Refund approval and decline are limited to `EFT_REFUND_APPROVER`. The `EFT_REFUND` role can create and list refunds but is refused with 401 on PATCH. The role that creates a refund is therefore different from the role that finalizes it.

- Transactions filter lists:
  - `product`: BCA, BUSINESS, BUSINESS_SEARCH, CSO, ESRA, MHR, PPR, RPPR, RPT, VS.
  - `paymentMethod`: BCOL, CREDIT_CARD, DIRECT_PAY, EJV, ONLINE_BANKING, PAD, INTERNAL, NO_FEE. EFT, CASH, CHEQUE and WIRE are not offered as filters.
  - `statusCode`: CANCELLED, PAID, CREDITED, PENDING, APPROVED, REFUNDED, REFUND_REQUESTED. OVERDUE, PARTIAL, DELETED, DELETE_ACCEPTED, COMPLETED, CREATED, SETTLEMENT_SCHEDULED, UPDATE_REVENUE_ACCOUNT and UPDATE_REVENUE_ACCOUNT_REFUND are not offered.

- `payment_method`: CC "Credit Card" (0420566ac811); EFT, WIRE, ONLINE_BANKING, PAD, EJV (1283463d3b4a); PREMIUM "Premium Payment" (1a4e08683cb2); DIRECT_PAY with description "Credit Card" (39a97401040c); CASH, CHEQUE (5b1ae231f7d2).
  - `payment_system`: PAYBC "Pay BC System"; BCOL "BC Online System"; FAS; CGI "CAS Generic Interface"; INTERNAL "Payments handled internally".
  - `status_code`: DRAFT, IN_PROGRESS, CREATED, COMPLETED, PARTIAL, FAILED, REFUNDED, CANCELLED.
  - `payment_status_code`: FAILED "Failed" (b05d371ad030).
  - `routing_slip_status_codes`: ACTIVE, COMPLETE, BOUNCED, NSF, REFUND, LAST, HOLD.

- **Refund job.** The payment-jobs task (`sbc-pay/jobs/payment-jobs/tasks/direct_pay_automated_refund_task.py`) polls the same PayBC payment endpoint and reads `refund_data` GL statuses. Its decisions:
  - rejected or declined: `refundglstatus in [RJCT, DECLINED]` gives `refund.gl_error`.
  - paid: `all refundglstatus == PAID` while the invoice is REFUND_REQUESTED.
  - complete: `all CMPLT`. This sets the invoice to REFUNDED, the payment to REFUNDED and `refund.gl_posted`.
  - It selects DIRECT_PAY invoices in [REFUND_REQUESTED, REFUNDED] with no `gl_posted` and no `gl_error`. It catches every exception per invoice, reports it to Sentry and continues.
  - Because `_refund_paid` returns when the invoice is not REFUND_REQUESTED, the PAID state only matters for REFUND_REQUESTED invoices.

- A payment redirect is sent only if the legal API returns `isPaymentActionRequired`. Otherwise the user lands on the dashboard with `filingId`.
- The Auth web payment page is public (`requiresAuth false`), so the pay link works without a login. The payment token in the URL is the only credential.
- The `?filing_id=` in the return URL is the only link between the payment return and the filing.
- AgmExtension and AgmLocationChg support only new filings (`filingId` must be 0). A draft id sends the user to the dashboard.
- Because `saveFiling` uses `hasPendingTasks`, a second new filing is refused while any draft or pending task exists for the business. That includes drafts of other filing types, and the check is on the business as a whole.
